description: heretek-swarm is an event-driven, actor-based framework for autonomous multi-agent collaboration. For conflict resolution and collective decisions, the Governance Engine (MAKER protocol) provides consensus and tribunal functionality. Concurrently, a Consciousness Module observes the event stream to compute emergent intelligence metrics (IIT Phi, Free Energy) for system-level observability. Infrastructure components supply LLM providers, configuration, and persistence backing the runtime.
